title: RT-qPCR Detection of SARS-CoV-2 from Wastewater Using the AB 7500
author: Jacquelina.Woods

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Master Mix for all sample and control reactions based on 25 µl reaction volumes, ensuring reagents are kept chilled.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mixes using the specified reagent mix compositions or individual components.
Use a 1:1000 dilution (in Primer TE) of FAM reference dye for the N1-N2-IC triplex assay.
Use a 1:10 dilution (in Primer TE) of ROX reference dye for the N1-IC and N2-IC duplex assays.
Adjust the amount of IC RNA template based on stock concentration to achieve a Cycle threshold (Ct) of 20-25 in negative control reactions without inhibition.
Thaw reagents in a bench top cool block (2-8 °C) or on ice in the master mix preparation hood; keep enzymes chilled continually as they are in glycerol.
Vortex reagent tubes for 3 seconds (+/- 1 sec) at medium high to high setting.
Briefly centrifuge all reagents for 5 seconds (+/- 2 sec) in a personal microcentrifuge.
Return all reagents to the cool block (2-8 °C) or ice.

steps.title: Add Internal Control (IC) RNA
steps.instruction: Incorporate the IC RNA into the Master Mix in a designated area separate from the initial Master Mix preparation.

substeps.instruction: Thaw IC RNA and sample RNA in the designated template addition hood/area.
Briefly centrifuge IC RNA for 5 seconds (+/- 2 sec).
Add 0.2 µL of IC RNA per reaction to the Master Mix while on ice/cold block.
Vortex briefly and centrifuge for 5 seconds (+/- 2 sec).

steps.title: Set Up Reactions
steps.instruction: Distribute the Master Mix and add sample RNA templates to the reaction tubes or wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 22 µL of Master Mix to each designated reaction tube or sample well.
Briefly centrifuge sample RNA for 5 seconds (+/- 2 sec).
Add 3 µL of sample RNA template to each of three reaction tubes or wells.
Include a negative (water) and positive PCR control in each reaction set-up.
Seal the sample plate or strip tubes and briefly spin for 5 seconds (+/- 2 sec).

steps.title: Configure AB 7500 Fast Instrument
steps.instruction: Initialize the run on the Applied Biosystems 7500 Fast instrument (software versions 2.0-2.3) using the specified experiment properties.

substeps.instruction: Set Experiment Properties to: '7500Fast (96 wells)', 'Quantitation Standard Curve', 'TaqMan Reagents', and 'Standard (~2 hours to complete run)'.
Set quenchers to 'NFQ-MGB'.
Identify target reporters: For N1-N2-IAC triplex, use N1-Joe, N2-Cy5, and IC-Texas Red; for duplex assays, use N1-FAM, N2-FAM, and IC-Cy5.
Select passive reference dye: FAM for triplex assay or ROX for duplex assays.

steps.title: Set PCR Run Parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the Run Method for a 25 µL reaction volume with the following thermal profile:

substeps.instruction: Holding stage 1: 50 °C for 50 minutes.
Holding stage 2: 95 °C for 15 minutes.
Cycling stage (45 cycles): 95 °C for 10 seconds, 56 °C for 25 seconds, and 62 °C for 1 minute.
Enable data collection on Step 3 of the Cycling stage.

steps.title: Adjust Analysis Thresholds
steps.instruction: Set the analysis thresholds and baseline cycles in the software.

substeps.instruction: For triplex assay: set N1 and N2 thresholds at 0.01 and IC at 0.1.
For duplex assays: set all thresholds at 0.01.
Set baseline start cycle at 3 and baseline end cycle at 10.

steps.title: Analyze and Validate Data
steps.instruction: Verify results using linear or log amplification plots and validate the run based on control performance.

substeps.instruction: Invalidate run if: Negative control is positive for any SARS-CoV-2 target; Positive control is negative (undetermined); or IC is negative in the negative control.

Determine sample is negative if: Controls are appropriate, sample is negative (undetermined) for targets, and IC is positive. (Note: MNV extraction control must also be positive for a valid negative result).
Determine sample is positive if: Controls are appropriate and at least one of the triplicate sample reactions is positive (Ct value indicated) for expected SARS-CoV-2 targets.
